english.title: Racially aggravated harassment - violent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to fear, on at least two occasions, that violence would be used against

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

by your course of conduct, which you knew or ought to have known would cause fear of violence

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

in that **(..DETAIL DATES IF DIFFERENT FROM ABOVE, PLACES AND NATURE OF CONDUCT..) which was racially aggravated in accordance with section 28 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32(1)(b) and (4) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is OBSOLETE. Now see CJS Code CD98071 and Offence Wording H10008.

(i) The option to return an alternative verdict of guilty of the basic offence is NOT available in the magistrates court, therefore the basic offence should be charged in addition to the aggravated offence.
(ii) Harassing a person may include alarming or causing the person distress; a "course of conduct" must involve conduct on at least two occasions and "conduct" includes speech.
(iii) The conduct must have taken place on at least two occasions on or after 30 September 1998.
(iv) If, on trial on indictment of a person charged with this offence, the jury find him not guilty of the offence charged, they may find him guilty of the offence of racially aggravated harassment under section 2 of the Protection from Harassment Act 1997 and section 32(1)(a) and (3) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.
(v) For the religiously or religiously/racially wordings see offence wordings H4744 and H4745.
